I went to this pet shop to get supplies for my puppy’s first week at home, and I didn’t really know what I was doing. The staff didn’t rush me and asked simple questions about his age and eating habits before suggesting food. One bag of treats I picked had a slightly torn seal at the counter, and they immediately swapped it without making it a big deal. The shop was a bit crowded when I visited, so moving around felt tight, but I still found everything I needed. It felt more like guided shopping than just buying products.
The doctor is very effective with his treatments. And the price is competitive.

¡Cash-only establishment! He is a good hands-on, general veterinarian. At reasonable prices and well cared for. He's gotten my pet's out of situations that were dire and knows his stuff. But if you're looking for x-rays, blood work, anesthesia, etc. he does not have the equipment for it, so you will have to go to a more advanced veterinarian.

There are a few picks that I will bring to attention for first-timers before they say anything bad about the establishment...

Time. One thing off the bat, you'll be waiting for a long time. Estimated 1 to 2 hours to get passed. I suggest you go early.

System/Organization. There's no organization or system for the people or the pets. Just walk-ins. So you'll have to remind the vet verbally and to face.

Environment. The environment can be very loud with music and dogs barking. So, if you have anxious pets, please keep this in mind.

Apart from these issues, we love taking our pets to him! I've been going for years and so has my familiars. We are always happy to see him grow in his career!
I highly recommend Geovanni, an excellent veterinarian. He is a blessing to our animals.
